description:
Local OpenAI-compatible router that aggregates free LLM providers.

FreeLLMAPI aggregates the free tiers of dozens of LLM providers, plus custom OpenAI-compatible chat, embedding, image, and audio endpoints, behind a single /v1 API.

A router picks the best available model for each request, falls over to the next provider when one is rate-limited, and tracks per-key usage so you stay under every free-tier cap. Provider keys are stored encrypted, and the router refreshes its model catalog from a signed feed. Built for personal use only; each provider's terms of service apply.
PowerTokens provider
- Add PowerTokens (api.powertokens.ai) as an OpenAI-compatible provider. Its glm-4.7-flash model is listed at $0 (0 Credits); chat, streaming and tool calling were tested through the app router.
- PowerTokens is often overloaded and answers 429 (code 1305). The router cools the key down and moves on, so treat it as an extra fallback rather than a primary route.
- Keys restricted to other models in the PowerTokens dashboard return 403 token_model_forbidden; allow glm-4.7-flash on the key.
The model arrives through the signed catalog. Premium receives the live catalog; Free receives the new row after the unchanged 30-day aging period. Thanks @PowerTokens for the original contribution (#1659).
Fixes
- Custom endpoints with several keys now rotate image, speech, transcription and embedding requests across those keys when one is disabled, out of budget, rate limited or rejected (#1738, fixes #1737). Thanks @w21180239.
- Free.ai is no longer offered for chat routing, and "Test" on a legacy non-chat model row explains that the platform does not support chat instead of reporting a missing key (#1769). Thanks @w21180239.
- "Probe now" gives reasoning models room for their hidden thinking (#1862).
- freellmapi setup-opencode stores the key in auth.json instead of an environment placeholder (#1861).
Docs
- Turkish README translation (#1805). Thanks @alkank.
